_comment: The lark-cli Base grammar, as DATA. Every entry was verified live against the pinned CLI and is quoted in skills/feishu-base/. The validator in build.py refuses exactly what the CLI refuses, offline, before a single call is made. Update this file when the CLI moves; no code changes.

rejections.records_as_object_array: batch JSON is COLUMNAR: {"fields":[...],"rows":[[...]]}. An array of record objects is rejected by the API.
rejections.field_name_key: field JSON is top-level {name, type, ...} — field_name / ui_type / property are rejected.
rejections.view_name_key: view JSON keys are name / type — view_name / view_type fail with 800010701.
rejections.filter_condition_object: --filter-json conditions are TUPLES [field, operator, value]; {"field":...} objects fail with 'Expected array, received object'.
rejections.link_property_wrapper: link_table rides at the TOP level of field JSON; a property wrapper or type:18 is rejected.
rejections.absolute_json_file: a --json @file path must be RELATIVE and inside the CLI's cwd; an absolute one is refused outright.

cell_dialect.number: a bare number, never a string
cell_dialect.select: the plain option string (reads return ["x"], writes take "x")
cell_dialect.link: [{"id": "rec_..."}] — ids READ off the target table, never constructed
